cohort: 160 patients with an average age of 34.6 years with symptomatic uterine myomas
finding: Minilaparotomy for myoma removal is a safe and effective treatment option for women with large or multiple myomas who desire to preserve their fertility, resulting in a high rate of postoperative pregnancy and live births.
mod_finding: 75.3% of the pregnancies were carried to term with 28.4% vaginal deliveries and 71.6% Cesarean sections.
